listing.name: BLACK (Xbox) (BLACK-XBERecomp)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Windows package; first-run local compilation from own USA/EU Xbox files Limits: Separate implementation from Spark198rus black-pc. BLACK.exe compiles the game code on first start; the optional source build is a separate route. Upstream platforms: Windows10+ x86-64 first-run local-compilation package, D3D12. No Linux/macOS player route established. Original data: Own USA or Europe original Xbox BLACK ISO or full extracted data in assets/. BLACK.exe locally compiles the selected game on first start. Manual source-build instructions specifically require USA default.xbe with the rest of its data; exact per-region executable hashes are not stated in reviewed README. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
